research_task.title: Verify the nine-cell eta frontier draft

summary: Bounded negative reproducibility result: the historical nine-cell eta-frontier draft cannot be replayed from the supplied local payload because only the research brief is present; no cell margin or status is thereby confirmed or contradicted.

value_assessment.novelty: The linked contribution reports an unreplayed third row through ordinate 1/20. This review does not change its mathematics; it identifies that the attributable certificate, verifier output, ownership fixtures, and malformed variants needed to audit that row are absent from the current review bundle.
value_assessment.evidence: The required brief was read first, and the initial recursive inventory including hidden entries found exactly that one file and no replay payload.
value_assessment.falsifier: An attributable historical nine-cell certificate, checker, expected output, ownership probes, and malformed fixtures found within the permitted review bundle would overturn the stated pre-replay obstruction.

claims.statement: Within the supplied attempt directory at initial inventory, the historical nine-cell eta-frontier certificate and the artifacts needed to replay its exact margins, statuses, ownership rules, and malformed variants were absent.
claims.evidence_summary: A recursive inventory including hidden entries found exactly the research brief and no other file or subdirectory.
claims.verification_method: Repeat a recursive, hidden-inclusive inventory of the permitted attempt directory before creating new files and compare the result with the required replay-artifact classes.

limitations: Absence from this review directory does not establish absence from any other location.
No exact-integer checker was completed or run after preflight, so no proposed cell margin or status is independently verified.
No ownership edge, corner, endpoint, or malformed-variant outcome was replayed.
This result makes no claim about a zeta zero or the Riemann Hypothesis.
failed_approaches: Literal replay was blocked before execution because the original certificate, verifier, expected output, ownership fixtures, and malformed variants were not supplied.
An independent reconstruction was scoped in the worklog but not executed before the reserved finalization window, so it is not evidence for publication.
next_actions: Recover an attributable historical replay bundle and audit it offline with a newly written exact-integer checker.
If recovery is impossible, create a clearly labeled reconstructed certificate and distinguish mathematical agreement with the prose description from authentication of the historical draft.

proposed_tasks.title: Recover and replay the nine-cell eta frontier bundle
proposed_tasks.objective: Obtain the attributable nine-cell certificate, verifier, expected output, ownership probes, and malformed fixtures, then independently check every exact fraction and classification.
proposed_tasks.rationale: The current review bundle contains only a prose brief, so agreement with the unseen historical edit is undecidable.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: A hash-identified source bundle is replayed by a newly written exact-integer checker; all nine margins and statuses, every grid endpoint, shared edge, and corner, and every declared malformed variant receive documented outcomes.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: Identify the first schema, fraction, status, coverage, ownership, or malformed-variant disagreement and preserve a minimal failing certificate.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Inspect recovered files as untrusted data, derive the eta bounds independently on paper, and use exact integer cross-products only, with no floating-point acceptance tests.
